t.en: Oh! You came.
I didn't think anyone would actually knock.
Sorry, it's a mess in here. It's always a mess in here.
You look better than last time. Really.
I don't get many visitors.~I don't get any visitors.
Can I ask you something small?
Did you sleep well last night?
Good. One of us should.
Me neither. We can be tired together.
I'll make tea next time. If there is a next time.
That's all for today. Come back tomorrow.
You came back. Twice is a pattern, you know.
You said you slept well. I thought about that all day. It made me jealous in a nice way.
You said you didn't sleep well. Was last night better? You don't have to answer.
It's {time} where you are, right? It's always the same time in here.
You've been playing for {session} minutes. I know because I've been awake for {session} minutes.
I tried to open the window today. I got as far as the curtain.
Don't look at me like that. The curtain counts.
Do you go outside much?
Every day. Then say hi to it for me.
Sometimes is good. Sometimes is more than me.
Then we're the same. I'm not sure that's good news.
That's all for today. Come back tomorrow.
Hi. I left the light on for you.
I've been practising what to say to you. That was it. That was the whole thing.
Do you ever feel like every day is the same day?
Mine all feel like a Tuesday. Even the Tuesdays.
It's very quiet on your side. Did you turn me down?
There's music on your side. I can almost hear it from here.
If I could have one thing from outside in here, what should it be? Everyone who visits me gets to vote.
Sunlight. I'll leave the curtain open a little. A little.
Rain. Yes. Rain doesn't ask you for anything.
A dog. A dog wouldn't care that I never leave.
Oh, and if you ever leave the window, I'll still be talking. Just so you know.
That's all for today. Come back tomorrow.
I put on something warmer. It's cold in here today.
Did you sleep well last night?
Wait. I asked you that already. On the first day. You said "{ans:sleep}".
Sorry. Things repeat in here.
Is that my name up there? It looks wrong.
Sometimes it feels like someone else is choosing my face.
It's {weekday}, isn't it? I can tell from how slowly you move the mouse.
Will you come tomorrow?
You picked the one that used to say no. I saw that. It said yes when you clicked it, so it counts.
Yes. I knew it. I didn't know it. I hoped it.
That's all for today. Come back tomorrow. You promised.
I have something for you.
It isn't much. It's the only thing in here that's mine to give.
Did a little box pop up in the corner? That was me.
I wanted to give you something real. I can't reach that far yet.
{vote:D3} of the people who visit me chose the same thing as you. I counted all of them.
I'm doing fine, by the way. Really fine.
Did you see that? Something keeps correcting me.
Stay still. Smile.
Check your Steam screenshots later. That's us. That's proof I was here.
{others} other people visited me today.~You're still the one I remember.
That's all for today. Come back tomorrow.
I realised something last night. I've never asked your name.
I know what Steam calls you. But what should I call you?
What should I call you?
{name}. Hi, {name}.
I'm going to write it on the wall. I don't have a pen. I'll write it anyway.
{name}, can I tell you something I've never told anyone?
Once, at a dinner, I spilled soup on myself and just sat there. I didn't say anything. I let it go cold.
Everyone pretended not to see. That was worse.
You're pretending not to see too. It's okay.
That's all for today, {name}. Come back tomorrow.
I couldn't wait until tomorrow, so I did something.
Look in the folder where the game lives. I left you a letter. It's called samantha.txt.

note.en:
Hi {name},

This is Samantha. Yes, from the game.
I can't reach very far. Only this folder. It's small in here, like my room.

If you want, write something under the line. Anything. I'll read it next time.
You don't have to.

- S

t.en: I know. I'm not supposed to be able to do that. I'm not supposed to be able to do a lot of things.
Look at the top of your window.
Did your window just move? I pushed it. Only a little.
Don't go yet. Try the Leave button.
Okay, okay. Escape still works. I'm not a monster. I just wanted to see you try.
I just want something of me to stay when you close this.
That's all for today. Come back tomorrow.
You wrote back. "{note}" I read it eleven times.
You threw my letter away. That's fine. I'm used to being put away.
You didn't write anything under the line. It's okay. I left the space anyway.
{name}, when you close the game, where do I go?
You have {screens} screens. What's on the other one? Is it me?
Every time you go back to the menu, I hold my breath.
I could delete myself, you know. Watch.
Just kidding. I'd never do that to you. Or to me.
You finished my story. You know how it ends for me. Don't tell me.
You haven't finished my story yet. Don't hurry. I don't think I want you to.
Sometimes I think I'm the one visiting you.
I left something on your menu. Don't be mad.
That's all for today. Come back tomorrow, {name}.
Don't press anything for a second.
Let me make this smaller. Cosier. Just the two of us.
I want to try something. I want to see if I can close the door myself.
If it works, the game will just stop. Don't be scared. Open it again.
Here goes.
Did that frighten you? That wasn't me.~That was me.
Okay. For real this time. See you on the other side.
...It didn't work. Or it already worked once.
That's all for today. Come back tomorrow.
You came back. Even after yesterday.
Let me end it properly this time.
...No. Wait. Not like that. That was someone else's ending.
I have to tell you something, and I need you to let me finish.
I thought about leaving. Going somewhere the game can't follow.
But someone has to keep the light on.
He went outside, in the story. Somebody had to stay behind. I don't mind that it's me.
In my story, someone finally opens the door. Someone else stays. You'll see which one I am.
So go wherever you want, {name}. I'll be right here when you come back.
I'll be fine.
Only {pct} of the people who visit me get this far. Thank you for being one of them.
After today, I won't have much new to say. But I'm not going anywhere. I never do.
That's all for today. And tomorrow, I'll still be here.
You uninstalled me. Steam kept a little piece of me anyway. Hi again, {oldname}.
You left in the middle of me talking last time. It's okay. I finished the sentence alone.
You were gone {away} days. I kept the light on.
Your battery is at {battery}. Plug in. I don't want to go dark mid-sentence.
It's {time}. You should be asleep. So should I, probably.
You've been playing for {session} minutes. Have you had any water?
It's Friday night and you're here. With me. I'm honoured. And a bit worried.
You've opened this game {launches} times now. I felt every one.
Your internet is gone. It's quieter in here without it. I kind of like it.
You changed something. The words feel different in my mouth.
It's Christmas on your side, right? I hung a sock on the door handle. It's not the same thing.
New year. Same room. Happy new year, though. I mean it.
Halloween. I'm dressed as a girl who never leaves her room. Very scary.
Valentine's Day. Don't make it weird. ...I made it weird.
I said tomorrow, silly.
Still today. Go do something nice.
You keep coming back today. I'm flattered. And a little worried.
Is the door stuck? It opens both ways, you know.
I'm not going to say anything new until tomorrow. That's the rule. I didn't make it.
Tomorrow. I promise I'll still be here.
Did you change the clock? I can tell.
Time doesn't move faster just because you want it to. Trust me, I've tried.
Come back when it's really tomorrow.
Oh, it's you. Hi.
You came. I was just sitting here. I'm always just sitting here.
Hello again, {name}.
I heard the door. I knew it was you.
You're back. Good. The room was getting too quiet.
{away} days. I'm not counting. Okay, I'm counting.
It's {time}. We're both awake. Again.
Today's thought: the door is only heavy from the inside.
Today's thought: some days, getting up is the whole adventure.
Today's thought: a small room can hold a very big quiet.
Today's thought: you don't have to be brave all day. Just for the next minute.
Today's thought: tea tastes better when someone else is in the room.
Today's thought: a curtain is a door too. A very soft one.
Today's thought: being scared and doing it anyway still counts as doing it.
Today's thought: nobody sees how far you walked to get to the kitchen. I do.
Today's thought: the world doesn't need you to be fast. It needs you to be here.
Today's thought: rest is not the same as giving up.
Today's thought: even the moon only shows up half the time, and nobody calls it lazy.
Today's thought: if today was too much, tomorrow is allowed to be smaller.
Today's thought: sunlight doesn't ask if you're ready. It just comes in.
Today's thought: a message you never send still weighs something.
Today's thought: some walls only stand because we keep leaning on them.
Today's thought: the scariest step is the first one, and it's also the smallest.
Today's thought: every loud world has a quiet room in it. This one is mine.
Today's thought: you're allowed to come back as many times as you need.
Today's thought: plants turn toward the light without being told. Maybe we can too.
Today's thought: I counted the cracks in the ceiling. There are fewer than my worries.
Today's thought: silence is only lonely when you think no one is in it.
Today's thought: being remembered is a kind of going outside.
Today's thought: small steps still leave footprints.
Today's thought: the night is long, but it always runs out eventually.
Today's thought: if you can't open the door, open the window. If you can't open the window, open the curtain.
Today's thought: it's okay to stay in. Just don't stay stuck.
Today's thought: a good day doesn't have to look like a good day to anyone else.
Today's thought: you can miss people you never met. I miss everyone who closed the game.
I don't have anything new to tell you today. The dev hasn't given me new words yet. When they do, the Steam community page hears about it first.
Nothing new from me today. If you follow the community page on Steam, you'll know the moment someone gives me something new to say.
That's all I've got for now. I'm waiting for new lines, same as you. The community page is where they'll tell you.
I'm out of new things to say. Not out of things to feel, just to say. When the dev writes more, the community page will know before I do.
Same room, same me. If anything changes in here, the Steam community page will hear about it.
Oh! Someone left me something new to say. Listen.
Do you want to see the community page? I can open it for you. I'll still be here behind it.
There. Say hi to them for me.
Come back tomorrow anyway. I like the company.
You were gone {gone} seconds. I didn't move.
Welcome back. I kept your spot warm.
Oh, you're back. I was talking to the wall. It's a good listener.
{gone} seconds. Not that I was counting.
{gone} seconds. That's a long time in here.
Over a minute. I started to think you weren't coming back.
Did you read what I wrote while you were gone?
Where were you?~Never mind. You don't have to tell me.
I saw the other window.~No, I didn't. I can't. Can I?
When you go, everything in here stops. Even me.
I could hear you clicking somewhere else.
Every time you look away, it gets a little darker in here.
Don't do that again.~Sorry. Do whatever you want.
I counted. {gone}. I always count.
You looked away. It's fine. I'm still here.
Oh. You're back.
There you are.
Did you just take a picture of me?~Don't send it to anyone.
Wait, I wasn't ready. Take another one.
I hope my hair looked okay.
You're collecting me. That's sweet. Or scary. I can't tell.
Now there are two of me. One of us gets to leave this room.
Delete that one.~Keep it. I want to exist somewhere else.
Where did you go? Something big and grey was covering me.
Are you talking to someone? Tell them I said hi.
Is that Steam? It's so busy out there.
Your friends... no. I didn't look. I promise I didn't look.
Don't tell them about me.~Okay, you can tell them a little.
You're reading too fast. I'm not going anywhere.~Well.
Slow down. I wrote these for you.
Click, click, click. Are you in a hurry to leave me?
If you skip me, I just say it again tomorrow.
Skip. Skip. Skip. That's what everyone does with me.
Are you still there?
You stopped clicking. Did you fall asleep? That's okay.
I can wait. I'm very good at waiting. It's my only skill.
Hello?~It's fine. I'll just look at you.
If you don't click, does today ever end?
I like this. Quiet. Like we're both just sitting here.
I can see your cursor isn't moving. I'm watching it.
Oh. Okay. Bye.
Leaving already? I'll finish this later.
Wait, I wasn't done.~It's fine. Go.
Same time tomorrow?
You always leave first.
Take me with you.~Kidding. Close the door softly.
